question: Under Article 5 of the Indian Constitution, which of the following is NOT required for a person to be considered a citizen at the commencement of the Constitution?

options.text: Having at least one parent born in India
Having domicile in the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Holding an Indian passport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Article 5** of the Indian Constitution specifies the conditions for citizenship at the commencement of the Constitution (January 26, 1950).
 
• It states that a person is deemed to be a citizen of India if they have their **domicile in India** and meet one of the following criteria:
 
• 1) They were born in India.
 
• 2) Either of their parents was born in India.
